versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.27.2 iife bundle (unminified): a CJS dep via __commonJS (vendor extraction + source-path handover), lazy and eager ESM modules via __esm and scope hoisting (the fossil split), enough wrapper-scope bindings to clear the frozen wrapper threshold after extraction, and a deterministic stdout report the boot step compares against the split tree. v1.1.0 perturbs the CJS dep (adds tripled), the pad width, and the report.
